title: Service Advisor - E. Complete an inspection (Submit and Generate Report)
preconds: Logged in as Service Advisor. WO = View/Create&Edit (no WO Delete) but WOL = V/E/D -> full inspection rights follow the LINE (SV-8095). An inspection is in progress with required fields fillable.
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open an in-progress inspection.
  3. Fill all required fields.
  4. Click Submit and Generate Report.
expected:
Step 3: With no required field outstanding, Submit and Generate Report is visible and clickable.
Step 4: The inspection is submitted, a report is generated, status becomes "Completed".
